definitions.explanation: A strong feeling of regret over past actions, often implying lasting pain or suffering from the memory.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{悔恨|かいこん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I deeply regret the decision I made at that time.

examples.japanese: {悔恨|かいこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。

notes:
FORMAL REGISTER:
This is a literary/formal word. In everyday speech, ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧ (regret) is more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {悔恨|かいこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ (feeling of remorse)
- {悔恨|かいこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (tears of remorse)
- {悔恨|かいこん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (filled with remorse)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧ (regret) - more common
- ⟦{自責|じせき}→自責：14885_jiseki⟧ (self-reproach)
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ (reflection, self-examination)
- ⟦{懺悔|ざんげ}→懺悔：18027_zange⟧ (confession, repentance)
